Boosted with chamomile, known to help soothe skin. • Fragrance type: Aromatic Woody • Notes: lavender, cashmere woods • 296 ml/10 fl oz. • Domestic

 Deliciously Dreamy Weekends: Indulgent Crème + Bare Vanilla

 Date Night Dessert: Indulgent Crème + Coconut Passion  
 Cozy After Dark: Indulgent Crème + Rich Cashmere + Warm Sandalwood 
 8-Piece Fragrance Mist Layering Set Includes:  
 Coconut Passion  
 • Fragrance type: Gourmand Coconut 
 • Notes: Coconut Milk, Warm Sands

 • Domestic

Your daily glow ritual, wrapping you in shimmering scent from head-to-toe. Brazilian purple passion fruit combines with pristine Shangri-La peony and creamy vanilla orchid for a tantalizing twist of fruits and florals, while Italian pine adds an intrigue that makes you inhale again and again.

 • 100 ml / 3.3 fl oz. 
 • Domestic

beauty.description_en:
A glimmering veil that wraps your skin in full-throttle sparkle from every angle.  
 Scented with our iconic #1 fragrance. Brazilian purple passion fruit combines with pristine Shangri-La peony and creamy vanilla orchid for a tantalizing twist of fruits and florals, while Italian pine adds an intrigue that makes you inhale again and again. 
 Directions: Shake well before use. Apply with brush on face and body, alone or after body care, skincare and makeup, wherever you want extra sparkle.  
 Fragrance type: Fruity Floral 
 Notes: purple passion fruit, Shangri-La peony, vanilla orchid 
 5 g/.17 oz 
 Domestic

beauty.description: Colección Marshmallow de edición limitada: mousse corporal batida que se siente como una nube sobre la piel y te deja suave, hidratada y oliendo a malvaviscos.
beauty.description_en:
The holiday beauty forecast? Soft and fluffy, with a side of sweetness. This limited-edition Marshmallow Body Care collection is what dreams are made of.  
 NEW! WHIPPED BODY MOUSSE 
 Make the daily self-care ritual extra fun and fluffy. This whipped dream of a body cream feels like a cloud going onto skin and leaves you feeling smooth, conditioned, hydrated and soft. Plus—it smells exactly like marshmallows! 
 GOOD TO KNOW 
 Our Body Mousses are shimmer-free formulas. 
 TO USE 
 It dispenses just the way whipped cream would—shake, turn upside down, and press the nozzle‚. Spread evenly all over body and rub in the same way you would a regular body lotion.  
 • 6 oz. 
 • Formulated Without Artificial Dyes  
 • Dermatologist Approved  
 • Against Animal Testing  
 • Vegan  
 • Packaging Partially Made with Recycled Materials

 • SCENT MADE WITH ESSENTIAL OILS 
 • DERMATOLOGIST APPROVED 
 • AGAINST ANIMAL TESTING 
 • VEGAN 
 • PACKAGING PARTIALLY MADE WITH RECYCLED MATERIALS

beauty.description_en:
Just dropped: A few new coconuts, just in time for summer. 
 NEW & LIMITED-EDITION 
 An indulgent tub of creamy, skin-loving, 24-hour moisturizing Body Butter in our best-selling Coconut scent? You're not dreaming, it's really happening. This must-have formula is enriched with natural butters, guarana extract and coconut oil to help skin appear smoother, feel softer, and smell like, of course, coconuts. Layer with Daily Dew Body Milk for extra hydrating benefits. This sweet treat was made just for summer, so get it while you can.  
 • 190g / 6.5oz 
 • Dermatologist approved 
 • Against Animal Testing 
 • Vegan 
 • Packaging partially made with recycled materials

 SMELLS LIKE: Vanilla crème, pumpkin spice, and fall feels. 
 THE DETAILS 
 Think of this body milk as the beauty version of a perfect white tee. Lightweight, layerable, versatile—and essential for the season. A bit lighter and silkier than our classic Daily Drench body lotion, Daily Dew Body Milk helps skin feel soft and hydrated and leaves a kiss of sweet pumpkin-vanilla scent. Here just for a few months, so get it while you can! 
 • 8 oz. 
 • Formulated Without Artificial Dyes   
 • Dermatologist Approved   
 • Against Animal Testing   
 • Vegan  
 • Packaging Partially Made Using Recycled Materials
